Good Afternoon Simone,

Apologies for the delay.

Please allow us some time to update you with the refund receipt. The refund has already been initiated from our side, and we are currently waiting for the concerned department to share the receipt with us.

As confirmed, you should receive the refund within 3–4 working days. However, please note that there are certain internal and banking processes that need to be followed, which is why we have advised a refund timeline of 7–14 working days.

Thank you for your patience, understanding, and cooperation.
